observation: Final render appears completely black with no visible flame/smoke or candle illumination.
expected_behavior: A visible candle flame (blue core to yellow/orange) emitting light, with minimal wispy smoke; nearby candle/holder surfaces should be faintly illuminated.
actual_behavior: No visible flame, smoke, or lit surfaces; frame reads as black/near-black.
recommended_fix: Increase render exposure and fire shader intensity (raise flame multiplier and temperature multiplier). Also fix Flow emission enabling: since FluidFlowSettings has no use_flow in this build, remove that assignment or set the correct equivalent property after printing fs.bl_rna.properties; ensure the flow is actually enabled so flame grid is non-zero.
analysis_notes: Render being near-black despite VDB cache suggests either (a) flame grid values are near zero and blackbody shading is too dim, or (b) flow emission is effectively off due to API mismatch (use_flow missing). First pass fix: raise exposure + boost flame_mul and temp_mul; second pass: confirm flow enable flag via fs.bl_rna.properties.
